/.title: Write HTML. Skip the build pipeline.
/.description: ItsyWeb adds layouts, partials and clean URLs to HTML, with a local dev server, SSH deployment and automatic HTTPS. No frontend build pipeline.

Write HTML.
Skip the build pipeline.

b8Ln3rR0yC.content: You wanted to make a website, not maintain a toolchain. Write HTML and CSS, reuse layouts and partials, and get clean URLs. ItsyWeb handles local development, server setup, deployment and automatic HTTPS.

/docs.title: Getting Started
/docs.description: Build a small bookshop website with two pages, shared templates, and your own CSS.

/docs/installation.title: Installation and updates
/docs/installation.description: Install the CLI once, then use it to create, preview, and publish your sites.

/docs/development.title: Local development
/docs/development.description: Preview changes as you work, check your site, and test it on another device.

/docs/templates.title: Pages, layouts and data
/docs/templates.description: Create pages, share markup, and bring JSON data into your HTML.

/docs/styling.title: CSS and icons
/docs/styling.description: Start with Prewind or use your own CSS. Add built-in Lucide icons directly in your HTML.

/docs/deployment.title: Server setup and deployment
/docs/deployment.description: Publish your site to an Ubuntu server with automatic HTTPS.

/docs/redirects.title: Migration redirects
/docs/redirects.description: Keep old links working when you move a page or bring an existing site to ItsyWeb.

/docs/seo.title: Search engines and SEO
/docs/seo.description: Give search engines your production URLs and keep selected pages out of search results.

/docs/recovery.title: Backups and recovery
/docs/recovery.description: Back up the live site, return to earlier code, or restore saved content.

/docs/editing.title: On-page editing
/docs/editing.description: Let an admin edit selected content on the website while you keep control of its HTML and design.

/docs/media.title: Photos, videos and collections
/docs/media.description: Make photos, videos, and repeatable lists editable on the page.

/docs/email.title: Email and contact forms
/docs/email.description: Add a contact form, preview messages locally, and configure delivery when the site goes live.

/docs/blog.title: Blog
/docs/blog.description: Add a blog with drafts, cover photos, and on-page publishing.

/docs/apps.title: Managed apps
/docs/apps.description: Add custom server-side behavior with a local executable that exchanges JSON with ItsyWeb.

/docs/agents.title: Working with coding agents
/docs/agents.description: Use a coding agent to build pages or add features using the project’s own instructions.

/docs/release-notes.title: Release notes
/docs/release-notes.description: Changes in the published releases, newest first.

/docs/support.title: About ItsyWeb and support
/docs/support.description: ItsyWeb is for websites you want to build with HTML and CSS, with the tools to run them included.
